text: The Nominating Panel - Corporations will conduct interviews and recommend three candidates to City Council for appointment to the Metro Toronto Convention Centre Board.

The Corporations Nominating Panel recommends that: 1. City Council appoint the following candidates to the Metro Toronto Convention Centre Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending July 20, 2025, and until successors are appointed: Scott Beck, Tourism Toronto Nikki Holland Jascha Jabes 2. City Council direct that Confidential Attachments 1 to 4 to the report (June 13, 2022) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Metro Toronto Convention Centre Board.
